build_anchor_head: build an AnchorHead instance with custom anchor generator scales, ratios, and strides config
forward_anchor_head: run a forward pass through the AnchorHead on multi-scale feature maps to get cls and bbox preds
get_anchors: generate anchor grids and valid flags for a batch of images given feature map sizes
get_targets: compute classification labels and bbox regression targets by assigning anchors to ground truth instances
loss_by_feat: calculate classification and bounding box regression losses for anchor-based detection head training
